original_description: Complete, battle-tested methodology for getting corporate sponsorships for any property with an audience — events, hackathons, conferences, festivals, nonprofits/charities, podcasts, creators, sports teams, associations, municipalities. Use this skill WHENEVER the user wants to find or land sponsors, write sponsorship outreach (cold emails/DMs/calls), build a sponsorship proposal/deck/prospectus/one-pager, price or value sponsorship assets, build a sponsor prospect list, prepare for or run sponsor discovery calls, handle sponsor objections, write a post-event fulfillment/wrap-up report, or renew/upgrade sponsors — even if they only say things like "we need sponsors", "how do I get a sponsor for X", "who should we approach", or "sponsorship strategy" without naming a specific deliverable. Distilled from The Sponsorship Collective (Chris Baylis): sell audience access and measurable outcomes (NOT logos), never use gold/silver/bronze tiers, and win through direct outreach + custom offers.

final_description: Use this skill to win corporate sponsorship money or in-kind support (cash, compute/API credits, prizes, swag) from companies and brands for any audience-based property: hackathons, conferences, festivals, events, podcasts, creators, sports/esports teams, nonprofits, charities, coding camps, associations. Covers the whole job — setting a revenue goal ("land $50k from brands"), starting from scratch ("bring in corporate partners, no idea where to begin"), getting companies to chip in, sponsorship strategy, prospect lists, outreach emails/DMs, discovery calls, building a deck/proposal/prospectus, pricing and valuing sponsorship slots or assets, handling objections or a ghosting/stalled prospect, wrap-up reports, and renewing or winning back lapsed sponsors. Fires whenever the user wants brands to sponsor or fund their event/show/team/cause. NOT for individual or major-donor gifts, grant writing, work-visa sponsorship, GitHub Sponsors, or audience growth.
